description: A polyphonic oscillator with four waves and a bank of eight sine harmonics, each harmonic on its own output and mixed into the sine output by its slider or by a scanning window

params.text: Shapes the fade at the edges of the scanning window, rounded anticlockwise and straight clockwise
Sets the pitch in semitones, four and a half octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Tunes the pitch by up to three semitones either way
Nothing in the module reads this control
Moves the scanning window across the eight harmonics, from the lowest anticlockwise to the highest clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the centre CV
Sets how many harmonics the scanning window covers, one at a time anticlockwise and all eight clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the width CV
Sets how far the FM input moves the pitch
Sets the level of that harmonic, at its own output and in the sine output; the eight run from the second harmonic to the ninth

inputs.text: Shapes the fade at the edges of the scanning window, 0-5V added to the slope trimmer
Sets the pitch, a volt to the octave, added to the frequency knob
Nothing in the module reads this jack
Moves the scanning window across the harmonics, attenuated by the centre attenuverter
Widens or narrows the scanning window, attenuated by the width attenuverter
Modulates the pitch by the octave, attenuated by the FM knob
Adds to the level of that harmonic, 1V opening it fully

outputs.text: The sine wave at the fundamental with the harmonic bank added to it, both the harmonics their sliders open and the ones the scanning window picks
That harmonic on its own as a sine wave, reaching 5V with its slider fully open; the eight run from the second harmonic to the ninth

notes: the harmonics picked by the scanning window are heard only at the sine output, while the sliders feed both that output and the harmonic outputs
